Episode 253: Gathering Once Again in Lafrarosa (6)
Bligiet repeatedly yelled to strike quickly, pointing a finger toward Beltian.
[Hic, sob!]
Seeing Beltian, who had suddenly started sobbing, Jin felt a conflicted emotion.
'To think that fellows like this are the ones talking about destroying the world or not... this is insane.'
There was no reason to hesitate further.
Striking him down now would not kill Beltian. If he could be restrained, it would be possible in some way to use him as the power source for the Battle God Temple.
Shh-!
A lightspeed thrust. Sword aura extending from Bradamante pierced through Beltian's chest. Beltian, far from forming a shield with sun energy to block it, seemed unable to even react at all.
[Keoheok!]

Before the scream could end, the blade, imbued with the Eternal Flame, once again slashed Beltian's abdomen. The damage was already significant, as Beltian stumbled backward, glaring at Jin and Bluggiet.
[Bligiet, you bastard...! Is this why you showed me the memory of the beginning!]
[No! It's a misunderstanding! I just wanted to awaken that beautiful emotion from when we were whole. The one attacking you now, it's this wicked mortal acting on his own!]
[You want me to believe that now, huh!? Ugh!]
Beltian hastily collected himself and prepared to counterattack, but by then, Bligiet was once again holding out the rainbow-colored sun energy.
[Believe me! And look at this again. We... were lonely...! Unspeakably lonely.]
[You son of a... hic, sob, sob sob! Ugh!]
Even while being mercilessly slashed left and right by Bradamante, the moment Beltian looked directly at the memory of the beginning, he was instantly overcome with sorrow and shed tears.
Jin decided not to think any further about how he should take in this spectacle, this battle that he couldn't bring himself to laugh at.
[Remember? Beltian, this part is the moment we first showed light to our creations... At that time, there weren't even mountains, fields, or seas.]
[Stop... stop it, ugh... sob.]
[We are going back to that time, so obediently accept Jin's sword.]
[You’re blaming Jin Runcandel for attacking me, aren’t you!?]
[Ah, that’s how it was. I got confused, here, look at this again…]
[Uuuugh!]
Countless stab and slash wounds were already carved into Beltian's body. Because the memory of the beginning kept interfering and slowing his reactions, he could do nothing against Jin.
As the main body took damage, the sun energy spread outside also gradually weakened. Naturally, the pressure on the Genesis Knights and the fleet was also decreasing.
Furthermore, thanks to Dante and Veradin's efforts, the energy of Araxion being transmitted to Beltian was also fading.
[Bligiet! I am Destruction itself. No matter what tricks you pull, in the end, I will do whatever it takes to destroy this world.]
[Yes, yes. It's obvious what card you have left, self-destruction? I shared this precious memory with you to stop you from doing that. If you don't believe me, try it. See if it works.]
[You bastard deserves to be torn to shreds!]
For Beltian, all he could do was spit out curses.
'Why the self-destruct...!'
Suddenly, the self-destruction wouldn't activate. As if something was blocking his inner self from heading towards Destruction.
It was emotion. The loneliness of those days, which had resurfaced because of the memory of the beginning, was suppressing his impulse.
Of course, as Bluggiet had said earlier, Beltian's weakness before the memory of the beginning would not be eternal, but it was enough time for Jin to subdue him.
'The sun energy is now distinctly weaker. It should be fine to have the fleet approach soon and prepare to use the restraints.'
Outside, even without Jin’s direct command, the fleet was already moving.
“It seems our brother has almost settled the situation inside. I will tighten the encirclement just in case, so you survey the surroundings. There may be other Ganestos besides the ones Lueth found.”
[Yeah, got it. I'm more worried about the Zipfel bastards than the Ganestos. It's not like them to not get involved in this.]
“For that side, Luna will probably contact us first before they arrive. She's a persistent child, it will be difficult for them to shake her off completely.”
As Murakan flew around the vicinity, the first thing he identified were the Ganesto knights, all kneeling with their heads cleanly severed.
Ran, Vygo, Myu, and Anne. All four had been defeated without putting up a proper fight against Dante.
The dimensional gate the Ganestos had been using was also completely destroyed. Veradin wiped the sweat trickling down his forehead and steadied his magical power.
[Are you all okay? Though I guess there’s no need to ask.]
“Murakan. I was fighting them moderately to see if there were any others, but all three were too weak.”

[They rely only on their authority to get stronger and think it's fine to just be resurrected if they die, so there's no way they could be strong. These things are nothing more than consumables within Ganesto.]
“That's right. The fact that Joshua did not come here can be said to be proof of that.”
“Isn't Joshua also quite incompetent? I don't get why they keep on to him alone. According to Lady Lucy's explanation, it seems he's become somewhat useful though.”
“We will now split up again and continue to be on guard for interference from the Zipfel and Ganesto, Murakan.”
[Yeah, the restraining of Beltian will be starting soon, so let's be thorough.]
For the coalition, it was a matter of finishing the restraint before the Zipfel and Ganesto could interfere again.
Now, it was the enemies who needed time, not the coalition. At this rate, they could achieve a smooth, great victory.

[Runcandel First Fleet, we will prepare to restrain the ego of the Sun God. Flagship Sarah, after opening the sword, prepare to charge. The rest of the fleet, finish checking the restraining equipment.]
“Yes, Head Butler!”
“Though I had some concerns when sending Bligiet down, it’s working out well, Lueth.”
[Yes, Lady Ameris. Now all we need is the Young Patriarch's order. The time until the restraint is complete... if the sun energy continues to weaken at this rate, it should be about ten minutes.]

The sun energy spread across the battlefield was now so faint it was hard to believe it had been spread by an ego of Destruction. It felt like even if Bale were to emit sun energy at full power, it would be stronger than this.
[Kgggh... now... it won't work anymore... Bligiet, be it the memory of the beginning or whatever, I won't be played by your tricks any longer!]
[Yes, you've worked hard, my other self, my friend. Now it is time to rest.]
Jin was already holding the communicator. Even if he had developed an immunity to the memory of the beginning, it was already too late.
“Begin restraint. All fleets, to your positions.”
The moment the order was given, the flagship Sarah, which had already opened its sword, rushed towards Beltian's eyeball.
Whoosh...!
Worn down by the memory of the beginning and Jin the whole time, his authority had weakened, so Beltian was left with only one eyeball again.
The Golden Fleet was forming a formation centered on the flagship Sarah. The ships all activated the restraining equipment that had been attached to their prows for this occasion.

Vahn also began to participate in the restraint, leading her lightning which she had spread like clouds. Soon, as Ameris and Lucy began to chant, the restraints, the lightning, and the blade of the flagship Sarah resonated, creating hundreds of blue rays of light.
The rays, which looked like giant ropes, were pouring down on Beltian's eyeball and body. Because Jin was forcing his movement, he couldn't even dodge.

[Living with mortals, you know, it wasn't all that bad. No, it was bad... it's scheduled to get better now. You will probably become like that too, Beltian. So don't feel too wronged. We are, after all, creators.]
[Ughhh...!]
The moment Beltian began to be swayed by the sensation of his entire body being suddenly bound.
'As expected, they've come.'
Suddenly, near the Golden Fleet that had deployed the restraints, the Zipfel fleet was appearing.
There was no trace of a dimensional gate. The Zipfel fleet was, literally, being 'created' in the sky.
[Young Patriarch, it is the enemy fleet. Created through reality manipulation.]
The troop creation they had experienced countless times during the first all-out offensive on the Tower of Stories.
Murakan was spreading his Advent of Darkness and his breath, completely destroying one of the first Zipfel fleets that had formed.
However, the Zipfel fleet continued to form anew without rest, like madly multiplying cockroaches.
To fight back, or to focus on the restraint.
Jin chose the latter without a moment's hesitation. In fact, he had been smiling from the moment the Zipfel created their fleet.

“Murakan and the rest of the fleet will be in charge of handling the enemy fleet. We will focus only on the restraint. The fact that the Tower of Stories is not appearing directly and is only creating troops means they don't have that much leeway.”
The matter at hand concerned none other than an ego of the Sun God.

'Their information must be late. Because they were avoiding sister Luna's pursuit. They must have been trying to continue the civilian massacres in the meantime, so they couldn't have thought that we would finish off Beltian this quickly.'
It was something he had intuited to some extent from the moment he saw that of the Zipfel and Ganesto, only the Ganesto were supporting Beltian first.
Since the Ganesto were hastily sending Araxion's energy to save Beltian, they might not have even had the capacity to quickly relay information to the Zipfel.

Furthermore, the formed fleet was much weaker than what they had experienced in the last battle at the Tower of Tales. Even without the coordinated Eternal Flame or Plutonian Domination Sword from the fleet like last time, they were crumbling like fallen leaves every time Murakan breathed his breath.
[Ugh, Jin. Is it really alright not to go and stop them? I'm anxious. How much longer until the sealing is finished? If this goes wrong, we won't be able to stop Beltian's self-destruction then.]

“We have already won, so just wait quietly, Bligiet. I am confident we can stop the Tower of Tales even if it appears directly, so a mere reality manipulation like this can have no effect on the outcome.”
[Still, it would be good if it were fast...]
“I get it. For now, you focus on thinking of ways to use Beltian’s power effectively once we’ve restrained him.”
At those words, Bligiet looked Jin in the eye with a confident face.

[Don't worry about that, Jin Runcandel. I told you, didn't I? That fellow is an ego of Destruction. If you restrain him, he will be consumed by rage and endlessly emit sun energy. If you just convert that, what you mortals commonly call a perpetual motion engine will be completed.]
